title: QUIC internal congestion-controller selector verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests for the selector and controller invariants, deterministic monotonic-clock tests, SpecTrace validation, and diff checks.
preconditions: The six CRT selector requirements are present in SPEC-QUIC-CRT.
The current path-state, congestion-control, recovery-timing, RTT, and monotonic-clock helpers remain available.
No public API widening is included in this slice.
scope: This artifact verifies the internal congestion-controller selector prerequisite only: default NewReno equivalence, internal CUBIC gating, immutable per-path controller choice, deterministic monotonic timing, path-local ACK/loss/ECN/persistent-congestion behavior, and PMTU/MSS-normalized congestion math. It does not verify unrelated HTTP/3, TLS, or public API work.
expected_result: Focused requirement-home tests pass for the six selector requirements, monotonic-time checks confirm deterministic controller transitions, and SpecTrace validation plus diff checks stay clean without any public API or support-promise widening.
procedure: Run the focused requirement-home tests for REQ-QUIC-CRT-0156 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0161.
Run the selector and monotonic-clock unit tests that cover the path-local controller state and deterministic time seam.
Run the repo-local SpecTrace validation profile.
